general.name: general
general.title: General
general.description: Minimum configuration to run this service. Found more advanced properties in 'Customize deployment' section.

discoveryInstanceName.description: Identity used for secrets creation and storage in Vault. It is the composition of the Discovery service name and the namespace where discovery is being deployed.
discoveryInstanceName.title: Discovery instance name

networking.name: networking
networking.title: Networking
networking.description: Tab to configure the default deployment of Discovery.

haproxyhost.description: URL host to access to your Stratio Discovery service. Usually in Stratio laboratories the value is any subdomain of xxx.labs.stratio.com, i.e. discovery.k8s.xxx.labs.stratio.com.
haproxyhost.title: URI host (in Stratio labs is any subdomain of xxx.labs.stratio.com i.e. discovery.k8s.xxx.labs.stratio.com)

haproxypath.description: URL path to access your Discovery service. The default value is ${Application.id} which includes also the namespace (e.g. discovery.keos-rocket)
haproxypath.title: URL path to access your Discovery service

proxyReadTimeout.description: Proxy read timeout in seconds applied to ingress and internal proxy. It must be higher than import/export timeout
proxyReadTimeout.title: Proxy read timeout (seconds)

datastore.name: datastore
datastore.title: PostgreSQL
datastore.description: Datastore where Discovery will place its configuration settings.

metadataDbIUrl.description: URL of the postgres database to connect in.Filled from Service Discovery section
metadataDbIUrl.title: Postgres connection URL (filled via Service Discovery section)

metadataDbUser.description: The user name needed to connect to the database.
metadataDbUser.title: Database user

dbConnectionTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for connecting to databases.
dbConnectionTimeout.title: Database Connection Timeout

postgresServiceId.description: Path of Database service instance to use during execution of prerequisites (creation of its own DB and related policies)
postgresServiceId.title: Postgres Service ID (filled via Service Discovery section)

jdbcParameters.description: An optional variable to append to the connection string additional JDBC configuration parameters. The default option helps JDBC to correctly manage pool connections.
jdbcParameters.title: Additional JDBC configuration parameters

postgresDatabase.description: The database name which stores Discovery metadata
postgresDatabase.title: Database name (default: Discovery service name)

postgresDatabaseCreation.description: Boolean flag to indicate if Postgres database must be created as a pre-deployment task
postgresDatabaseCreation.title: Create Postgres database as a pre-deployment task

postgresDbCreationClusterName.description: Postgres service name used to create the database.
postgresDbCreationClusterName.title: PostgresDB cluster name (filled via Service Discovery section)

postgresNamespace.description: Postgres namespace used to create the database.
postgresNamespace.title: PostgresDB namespace (filled via Service Discovery section)

enableOauth.description: Whether to activate oauth enable. Must be set to true if the authentication is via 'gosec-sso'
enableOauth.title: Enable OAUTH

authenticator.description: Authenticator method to use (gosec-sso, headers, jwt, metabase-native)
authenticator.title: Authentication method

ssoOptions.name: ssoOptions
ssoOptions.title: Gosec SSO Authenticator Settings
ssoOptions.description: In this section you manage Gosec SSO Authenticator settings.

adminGroup.description: Gosec SSO group that will have Administrator privileges in Discovery.
adminGroup.title: Admin group

createAndSyncGroups.description: Whether to create in Metabase the received SSO groups of the user and sync them every login.
createAndSyncGroups.title: Create and sync user groups in Metabase

useGroupWhitelist.description: whether to filter access to discovery based on a whitelist of user groups.
useGroupWhitelist.title: Use group whitelist

groupWhitelist.description: comma separated list of groups that will be allowed to access Discovery
groupWhitelist.title: Allowed groups

serviceURL.description: Public facing url of the service
serviceURL.title: SERVICE URL

ssoUri.description: Full external url where the Gosec SSO server is running (including port or subpath, depending on configuration).
ssoUri.title: SSO external URI

ssoUriInternal.description: Full internal url where the Gosec SSO server is running (including port or subpath, depending on configuration).
ssoUriInternal.title: SSO internal URI

cpuResourceType.description: Kubernetes CPU resource type: guaranteed/hard/soft limits. Guaranteed -> request equal to limit. Hard -> limit can be greater than request. Soft -> No limit
cpuResourceType.title: CPU resource type

memResourceType.description: Kubernetes Memory resource type: guaranteed/hard/soft limits. Guaranteed -> request equal to limit. Hard -> limit can be greater than request. Soft -> No limit
memResourceType.title: Memory resource type

javaInitialRamPercentage.description: Initial size of the Java heap as a percentage (0 - 100) of the total memory available to the VM. Corresponding to '-XX:InitialRAMPercentage'. Default 30.0
javaInitialRamPercentage.title: Initial size of the Java heap as a percentage

javaMaxRamPercentage.description: Maximum size of the Java heap as a percentage (0 - 100) of the total memory available to the VM. Corresponding to '-XX:MaxRAMPercentage'. Default 70.0
javaMaxRamPercentage.title: Maximum size of the Java heap as a percentage

metrics.name: metrics
metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: JMX and Prometheus metrics configuration for service and asset executions

prometheusMetricsEnable.description: Allow metrics to be sent to Prometheus
prometheusMetricsEnable.title: Use Prometheus metrics

discoverycicdLogLevel.description: Log level of the import/export collections service
discoverycicdLogLevel.title: Discover import/export log level

settings.name: settings
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configuration of JDBC options, the default admin user, akka timeouts and other custom settings.

import-export.name: import-export
import-export.title: Import/Export service
import-export.description: Configure import/export service. This feature can be used for promote collections, dashboards, questions ... over environments.

akkaRequestTimeoutImport.description: Akka request timeout for Discovery-cicd api. Specific to Import operation.
akkaRequestTimeoutImport.title: Akka request timeout. Import operation.

akkaRequestTimeoutExport.description: Akka request timeout for Discovery-cicd api. Specific to Export operation.
akkaRequestTimeoutExport.title: Akka request timeout. Export operation.

cicdJavaInitialRamPercentage.description: Initial size of the Java heap as a percentage (0 - 100) of the total memory available to the VM (relevant to server and workers). Corresponding to '-XX:InitialRAMPercentage'. Default 10.0
cicdJavaInitialRamPercentage.title: Initial size of the Java heap as a percentage

cicdJavaMaxRamPercentage.description: Maximum size of the Java heap as a percentage (0 - 100) of the total memory available to the VM (relevant to server and workers). Corresponding to '-XX:MaxRAMPercentage'. Default 25.0
cicdJavaMaxRamPercentage.title: Maximum size of the Java heap as a percentage

cicdJavaOptions.description: Add custom Java options to CI/CD service (excluding memory options).
cicdJavaOptions.title: Java options for the Import/Export collections service.

cicdApiMetabaseTimeout.description: Akka http client timeout used in Metabase API requests
cicdApiMetabaseTimeout.title: Akka http client timeout used in Metabase API requests

nginx.name: nginx
nginx.title: Nginx
nginx.description: Configure internal Nginx options in order to improve Nginx performance.

nginxEventConnections.description: Sets the maximum number of simultaneous connections that can be opened by a worker process for Nginx configuration (i.e: worker_connections into events section)
nginxEventConnections.title: Event connections for Nginx

nginxWorkerProcesses.description: Sets the number of worker processes for Nginx configuration. The optimal value depends on many factors including (but not limited to) the number of CPU cores, the number of hard disk drives that store data, and load pattern. When one is in doubt, setting it to the number of available CPU cores would be a good start (the value 'auto' will try to autodetect it).
nginxWorkerProcesses.title: Worker processes for Nginx

nginxClientMaxBodySize.description: Sets the maximum size of the body that Nginx accepts for CI/CD endpoint (This value corresponds to Nginx parameter :client_max_body_size)
nginxClientMaxBodySize.title: Max Body Size for CI/CD endpoint

createSampleDatabaseOnInit.description: On new deployments, whether to create or not the Metabase sample database.
createSampleDatabaseOnInit.title: Create Metabase sample database

virtualizerSkipStmtCancellation.description: Wheter to skip or not in the Virtualizer driver the Statement cancellation performed by Metabase at the end of all query executions, which may cause problems by not closing and returning the connections to the pool.
virtualizerSkipStmtCancellation.title: Skip Metabase's Statement final cancellation in Virtualizer driver

approlename.description: Role of the app used for dynamic authentication.
approlename.title: Secret Role

oauth2CookieName.description: Name of the cookie provided by SSO.
oauth2CookieName.title: OAuth2 cookie name

oauth2Proxy2LogoutUrl.description: URL where to send users when they logout from Discovery. Should redirect to the logout URL of the KEOS oauth2proxy, which will delete the stratio-cookie. Should include the `rd` query param so that just after logout, if the user logs in again, it will be sent again to Discovery instead of to the KEOS default.
oauth2Proxy2LogoutUrl.title: OAuth2Proxy logout URL

ACL(resourceType Foreign Data Wrapper, name ${postgresDatabase}.*, actionsAllow [Usage], actionsDeny [], recursive false)
ACL(resourceType Large object, name ${postgresDatabase}.*, actionsAllow [Select, Update], actionsDeny [], recursive false)
ACL(resourceType Type, name ${postgresDatabase}.*, actionsAllow [Usage], actionsDeny [], recursive false)
ACL(resourceType View, name ${postgresDatabase}.*, actionsAllow [Select, Insert, Update, Delete, Truncate, References, Trigger], actionsDeny [], recursive false)
ACL(resourceType Schema, name ${postgresDatabase}.*, actionsAllow [Create, Usage], actionsDeny [], recursive false)
ACL(resourceType Database, name ${postgresDatabase}, actionsAllow [Create, Connect], actionsDeny [Temporary], recursive false)
ACL(resourceType Table, name ${postgresDatabase}.*, actionsAllow [Select, Insert, Update, Delete, Truncate, References, Trigger], actionsDeny [], recursive false)
ACL(resourceType Foreign Server, name ${postgresDatabase}.*, actionsAllow [Usage], actionsDeny [], recursive false)
ACL(resourceType Language, name ${postgresDatabase}.*, actionsAllow [Usage], actionsDeny [], recursive false)
